valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing, no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance $11.05-$11.15 (midpoint $11.10, raised Oct 13 2026) on sales of about $101.2B. FY2027 EPS is my own assumption (no sourced consensus or company 2027 guidance); it assumes mid-single-digit growth as Stelara erosion and M&A dilution (Firefly Bio, Sail Biomedicines) are offset by Innovative Medicine launches and a MedTech recovery from about 2.5% growth in Q3.

bear.driver: Stelara and other loss-of-exclusivity erosion plus M&A dilution outrun launches; MedTech stays near 2-3% growth; talc settlement costs and rate pressure on the sector multiple.

base.driver: Adjusted EPS grows about 6% from the $11.10 FY2026 midpoint as oncology and immunology launches offset Stelara erosion; MedTech improves modestly; multiple roughly holds near the current premium.

bull.driver: Innovative Medicine growth accelerates with new launches, MedTech recovers to mid-single-digit growth and talc is resolved cleanly, supporting a premium defensive multiple.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $11.80 the $285.75 close implies 24.2x; the equal-weight average of the pre-close named targets (about $296) implies 25.1x on $11.80, or about $12.35 EPS at 24x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $11.80 (about 4.1 pp of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Innovative Medicine operational sales growth after Stelara erosion and MedTech operational growth (Q3 2026: about 2.5%), plus 2027 adjusted EPS guidance.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results with initial 2027 guidance, expected mid-January 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Seven named calls sourced from a single aggregator table: six Buys (Morgan Stanley, UBS, Goldman Sachs, RBC, TD Cowen, Scotiabank) with targets of $280-$320, and an Erste Group downgrade to Hold on Oct 21 with no target. Morgan Stanley trimmed $294 to $292 the day after earnings; the other prior values were not sourced. The targets average about $296, roughly 3-4% above my base case, equal to about $0.50 of FY2027 EPS at 25x or about one turn of multiple. Leerink (Nov 17) and Bank of America (Nov 18) calls fall after the reference close and are excluded; a TD Cowen Underweight snippet conflicts with the Buy and was disregarded. Horizons are not documented, so no target enters the weighted average.
